conflicts_notes: Current charter cleanly limits direct-voter offices to Mayor, nine Town Councilors, and six separately elected School Committee members; Mayor school membership is ex officio.
Current code is unusually explicit: five elected constables and five elected Finance Committee members coexist with appointed Treasurer, Parks, and Water/Sewer bodies.

Finance Committee and Parks/Recreation are direct-voter elected; Up-Island committee has five district-elected seats. MVRHS representation is derived/appointed rather than a separate direct-voter post.

2022 charter provides core elected offices. Current/historical elected-official roster adds Assabet Valley regional-vocational and Soldiers’ Memorial positions; Housing is normalized to three direct-voter seats.

Direct-voter structure includes Mayor, 13 Councilors, six School Committee seats, six ward Municipal Light Board seats, and a rotating three-seat elected Athenaeum trusteeship; appointed MLB seat and Mayor school role excluded.
